Original Northbridge river measurement by Birch Municipal Water Laboratory. Our own field team collected this reading independently on 2026-10-01 using our separately calibrated sensor at survey point 1. Measured level: 241 centimetres. Our raw instrument logs are our own. We do not reuse a wire report, press release, quotation or another institution's measurements. Field method: independently sampled staff gauge, logged by our own observer. This is an authored controlled validation fixture, not a real incident.
